note: Tennessee State Parks campground in hardwood forest on the Kentucky Lake shore near Buchanan, a short walk from the park's marina, swim beach and inn; camping cabins too. --Claude
summary: Paris Landing SP: page and calendar confirm 45 W/E (30/50A) + 18 primitive, RVs to 38 ft, two bathhouses, dump, laundry, store, year-round. Calendar now $32-35 (primitive $19-21), consistent with stored $32-39 (June 2027 high) - fees unchanged. Phone empty -> 731-641-4465. PIN move ~640 m to the loops. Not waterfront kept.
flags: PHONE: '' -> '731-641-4465' (campground map 'Park Office: 731-641-4465', also Google). The park page also shows 1-931-325-6655 next to the camping link (unexplained; not used); reservations 1-888-867-2757.

PIN MOVE (~640 m): stored 36.4358,-88.0817 is south of US-79 by the inn/lodge grounds; the campground loops (sites 1-63) are north of US-79 and east of TN-119, about 36.4405,-88.0858 (Google's campground point 36.43998,-88.08463 is at the entrance/check-in side of the loops).
FEES unchanged: Calendar View 2026-11-26..12-10 prices hookup sites $32/$34/$35 and primitive $19-21; stored $32-39 (high from June 2027, read 2026-10-12) stands.
WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' kept: loops in hardwoods, the marina basin ~200 m east of the nearest loop; no site at the shore on the map.

POLICY ROW: the reservation page says 'Most campsites require a minimum of a 2-night stay.' and the max stay is 14 nights (28 Dec 1-Feb 28/29); check state:TN carries these (not written here per the state-park inheritance rule). Check-in 4 pm / check-out noon (campground map).

SITES: the campground map numbers 1-63 include six camping cabins (30, 31, 34-37), so the map shows 57 campsites against the reservation page's '45 ... as well as 18 primitive' (63); count 63 kept as the agency states it.
